name: integral_subsystem_per_step
source:
{ The subsystem is re-solved at every quadrature step: x = 2t, so
  the integral of x^2 from 0 to 1 is 4/3 and the final x is 2.
  Java IntegralTest.solvesSubsystemAtEveryStep. }
x = 2*t
F = Integral(x^2, t, 0, 1)
